about.intro: I'm a *Software Engineering Student* & *Web Developer* based at **Amity University, Gwalior**.
about.description: Pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) with a strong interest in software development and technology research. Driven to build **efficient, scalable, and user-friendly** applications.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Rza Mohammed**. I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at Amity University, Gwalior, with a strong interest in software development and technology research. My goal is to become a skilled Software Engineer capable of building efficient, scalable, and user-friendly applications.

I build full-stack web applications using **React**, **Next.js**, and **Node.js**, and leverage **AI-assisted development tools** to rapidly prototype and ship products. My workflow blends modern frontend frameworks with automation scripts and data-driven utilities.

I actively participate in hackathons, business competitions, and technical events to challenge myself beyond academics and sharpen my real-world problem-solving approach. Key highlights from my journey include:

• **1st Position** — SISTec Brand Combat, Sagar Exuberance 4.0, Bhopal
• **2nd Prize** — Smart Campus Ideathon 2026, Amity University Gwalior
• **2nd Runner-Up** — ARIC'25, ABV-IIITM Gwalior
• **2nd Runner-Up** — IIITM Gwalior Hackathon & Innovation Pitch
• **2nd Prize** — National Science Day 2026
• **Technical Team Coordinator** — Amity Coding Club (ACC)

These experiences strengthened my coding skills, teamwork, leadership, and presentation abilities. I am continuously learning new technologies, building projects, and exploring software development as a career path. I aim to join a growth-oriented environment where I can contribute meaningfully and evolve as a technology professional.

projects.title: AmityConnect
projects.category: Smart Campus Safety Platform — 2nd Prize, Amity Ideathon
projects.description: Hyper-local campus platform with emergency alerts, ride-sharing, and gamified peer service marketplace. Shipped from ideation to working prototype. Coordinated design, backend, and frontend across the team under time constraints. Features include real-time emergency notifications, integrated ride-sharing for safety, and a reputation system for peer services.

projects.title: Amity OD Portal
projects.description: Automates On-Duty request generation for students attending college events. Reads Excel attendance data, cross-references it against the academic timetable to detect missed lectures/labs, then auto-generates faculty-ready emails and downloadable reports.

projects.title: Smart Link Hub
projects.description: Link-in-bio style hub for consolidating and sharing multiple links from a single page. Built with an AI-assisted, component-driven process.

projects.title: Smareet
projects.description: Smart campus platform designed to enhance the student experience with streamlined campus services and community features.
